fact: The New Times reports that from January 2025 Rwanda's justice sector and its stakeholders will begin using an upgraded Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS).
The 13th Rwanda Governance Scorecard (RGB, 22 October 2026) scored electronic court filing services at 65.40% satisfaction, down 13.60 points on the previous assessment.
Certa Foundation says the updated Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) manages cases from investigation to execution, with case tracking and a block on duplicate registrations.
Certa Foundation says lawyers trained on 23 January 2025 create IECMS accounts and file civil and criminal cases and submit documents digitally.

The Chief Justice says the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS), introduced in 2016 after earlier electronic filing and record systems, is in use and manages cases from filing to judgment.

The Institute of Legal Practice and Development reports that 30 MAJ officials began training on 22 April 2024 on an upgraded Integrated Electronic Case Management System, with a launch slated for July 2024.
Tech Review Africa says Rwanda has made significant progress digitising justice services, particularly through the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS).
